title: Primary garden area minimum area (Table 1.1b)
text: Primary garden area (applies to R50-R80; R100-SL; LR, MR and HR only). C1.1.3 A single consolidated primary garden area to be provided in accordance with Table 1.1b. Table 1.1b Primary garden area provisions. Site area (m2) | Minimum primary garden area (m2 per dwelling): Greater than 220 35; 191-220 30; 161-190 25; 131-160 20; 100-130 16. Site area rounded up to the nearest whole number. C1.1.4 Notwithstanding C1.1.3, for dwellings with a site area of 161m2 or greater, the required primary garden area in accordance with Table 1.1b may be reduced by 10m2, where a secondary ground level private open space is provided outside of the street setback area with: i. a minimum area of 10m2 and minimum dimension of 3m (refer Figure 1.1c) ii. uncovered and open to the sky (excluding minor projections); and iii. an additional small tree provided in addition to the minimum provisions of Table 1.2a.

exceptions.label: C1.1.4 secondary private open space on a site of 161 m2 or more: required PGA reduced by 10 m2

replaces.note: each site-area band reduced by 5 m2; 100-130 band 20 -> 16
C1.1.4 concession was grouped dwellings only; now single houses (not in ToC)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

verified.note: Values clear. Table 1.1b note 2 cites 'Figure 1.1b' but the PGA figure on the page is labelled Figure 1.1a (drafting error, no effect on values).

notes: Single consolidated PGA; area by site-area band (site area rounded up to the nearest whole number; the table bands are ordered so exact boundaries fall in the lower band). C1.1.4 is encoded as an exception here rather than as a rule, because a concession not taken must not fail the element. R100-SL is governed by C1.1.3-r100sl (Table 2.10a). Table 1.1b note 2 cites 'Figure 1.1b' but the PGA figure on p10 is labelled 'Figure 1.1a' (register ch2-004).
